title: Economics - 2026-27 Professional-Track Faculty Pool
description:
Economics - 2026-27 Professional-Track Faculty Pool

College/School/Unit: College of Liberal Arts
Department: Department of Economics
Posted: Oct 6, 2026
Apply By: Aug 15, 2027

Description

The Department of Economics seeks to develop a pool of candidates
for possible temporary/non-tenured positions to teach undergraduate
and graduate courses. Positions are not available every semester
and are contingent upon student enrollment and the availability of
funding. Appointments are usually made on a semester-by-semester
basis, though sometimes there is departmental need for an annual
appointment. Positions are renewable annually, contingent upon
budgetary funding and performance.

Qualifications

Applicants must hold a PhD in Economics.

Application Instructions

Candidates should submit a current CV, 3 original letters of
reference, and a cover letter.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

The University of Texas at Austin, as an equal
opportunity/affirmative action employer, complies with all
applicable federal and state laws regarding nondiscrimination and
affirmative action. The University is committed to a policy of
equal opportunity for all persons and does not discriminate on the
basis of race, color, national origin, age, marital status, sex,
sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, disability,
religion, or veteran status in employment, educational programs and
activities, and admissions.



To apply, visit https://faculty.utexas.edu/career/191288
